records.evidence: The official FSU business school page identifies Marketing as its own department, distinct from the reviewed Business Analytics, Information Systems and Supply Chain department. The historical imported College of Business, Marketing assertion is a real nonqualifying unit title; it must not be mapped to supply-chain or Industrial Engineering units merely from the recruiting context.
